summary: Produced the insights-domain ownership decision as ADR 0013 (docs/adr/0013-insights-plugin-ownership.md), after checking the shipped contracts and runtime: ReconciliationCase is x-owner=insights owned_fact and MetricDefinition is x-owner=insights read_projection, the frozen commands are insights.reconciliation.refresh/v1, insights.reconciliation.case.update/v1 and insights.export.create/v1 with matching canonical events, current migration leaves are core 0010 / contracts 0003 / cash 0006 / settlement 0005 / costing 0004, the plugin runtime still has exactly 8 manifest fields, fixed PMO_PLUGIN_MODULES, app-run migrations and no URL registration point, and the read-only sources are cash/settlement/costing/contracts/management_revenue plus AccountingPeriod/locked_through. The ADR compares option A (new pmo_plugins.insights app), B (reuse delivery/management_revenue), C (core read-only services) and D (defer), with criteria for canonical-owner consistency, migration isolation and sequence collisions, manifest/requires fit, entry gating/routing, read-only boundary, relationships to the existing owners and test/deploy/rollback cost; it decides option A: a new pmo_plugins.insights app as the insights write owner for reconciliation cases/read models. It freezes the 8-field manifest (id=insights, requires cash/settlement/costing/contracts, capabilities empty), an app-owned migration chain from 0001 with no rewrites of core 0010/contracts 0003/cash 0006/settlement 0005/costing 0004, settings/PMO_PLUGIN_MODULES/delivery-urls root single-write registration, named-service/browser-only reconciliation refresh/case.update in the first slice (export deferred, no PAT/MCP/payment/close-lock tools), read-only derived models with no editable balances or second books, no ledger/revenue/cost/cash/open-item writes, a read-only relationship to the existing owners and period/lock state, and PH-257/PH-262/PH-272 kept proposed on their upstream dependencies. PH-257 and PH-262 specs/tasks gained the bootstrap/settings/urls whitelist entries so the future implementation is executable, PH-272's owner note now cites ADR 0013, and their blockers reference the decision. No scaffold, product code, migration or contract-schema change was made.
